test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said, “I love to eat pineapple.”

options.text: She said that she love to eat pineapple.
She said that I loved to eat pineapple.
She said that she loved to eat pineapple.
She said that she had loved to eat pineapple.

solution:
The correct answer is **"She said that she loved to eat pineapple."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The pronoun 'I' changes to 'she.'
 
• The verb** "love" **in the original sentence needs to be changed to past tense** "loved"** in the reported speech.
 
• Simple Present Tense (say) converts to Simple Past Tense (said).
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1 + object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He leaves the room.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he left the room. *

 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: *She said that she loved to eat pineapple.*
